Our first-ever single-origin, specialty Half-Caff comes from Yelnoorkhan Estate. We selected their S795, washed processed coffee to create a complex and distinctive cup. To reduce caffeine by 55%, we used CO₂ decaffeination, a chemical-free, minimal-waste generating method that is conscious in its water and energy usage. We chose it because the other decaffeination methods available to us in India came with a catch. In removing all the caffeine, they also took away the depth that makes a cup memorable. Adding artificial flavours was not something we wanted to do, never mind the fact that many of these methods also used far too much water. The result is a cup with a gentler kick that holds its own in terms of flavour. You’ll first notice chocolate biscuits on the nose as well as your palate. A silky mouthfeel then reveals notes of roasted hazelnuts and malt, followed by a long, nutty finish. For the best experience, brew this coffee using an espresso machine. origin: Te , Yercaud In Tamil Nadu, Each Cherry Is Carefully
description_raw: Iceberg, Our final limited release of the year, crafted to mark the close of 2025 with something truly special. This exceptional coffee embodies a meticulous, hands-on approach to quality that elevates it beyond the ordinary. Starting its journey at Riverdale Estate , Yercaud in Tamil Nadu, each cherry is carefully hand-picked where slower maturation enhances sugar content and mucilage density, key aspects of natural process coffee . The processor ensure only the ripest cherries move forward, using a Brix meter to measure sugar levels precisely. Once harvested, the cherries undergo a thorough triple wash using natural spring water from its own estate to remove impurities, followed by a floating process to eliminate underdeveloped beans. The highest-density cherries are fermented with the addition of rose petals, enhancing the development of flavonoids and bringing out cleaner, brighter fruit notes along with a unique floral character. After fermentation, the cherries are slow-dried on raised beds for up to 30 days, promoting even drying and improved air circulation. This careful process ensures a vibrant, clean cup. The coffee is hulled in our dry mill, where our quality control team meticulously hand-picks any defective beans. To maintain maximum freshness, all our natural process coffees are vacuum-sealed to preserve moisture levels between 11–13%. Roasted to perfection by our head roaster, Baninder Kochar, Iceberg coffee is profiled for a clean, balanced cup that highlights delicate exotic florals, complemented by Savorworks’ signature long, lingering aftertaste. Expect bright, clean flavors with tasting notes of hawflakes (nostalgic Chinese confection), plum blossom, persimmon, and mango. Facts: Estate: Riverdale Estate Process: Iceberg Naturals Varietal: SLN9 &  5B Altitude: 1450 MASL Feels: Tasting Notes: Haw Flakes, Plum Blossom, Persimmon, Mango Acidity: Malic Body: Medium Aftertaste: Long Size - 250gm / 1kg

origin: Sourced From Two Of The Finest Farm
description_raw: Introducing "Rosselle Blend" Rossette’s first international blend - where India meets Colombia in a cup. Sourced from two of the finest farms i.e. Ratnagiri Estate in Karnataka, India & Finca el Diviso in Huila, Columbia , this coffee is a vibrant interplay of different terroirs, roasted medium-light to highlight versatility and character. Bright and expressive , this cup opens into juicy tropical sweetness and lifted florals, with lychee, custard apple, and ripe berries at the forefront, softened by delicate white floral notes. The combination of yeast anaerobic fermentation and thermal shock processing brings a rounded structure and smooth, almost velvety mouthfeel, while maintaining a refined, clean finish. Roasted medium-light , this blend is designed to shine across brew methods - suited for both filter and espresso brews .

origin: Ate, Chikmagalur Is A Refined Expression Of The Hydro Ho
description_raw: This lot from Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur is a refined expression of the Hydro Honey process, a method that blends elements of washed, natural, and honey processing to create a cup with layered complexity and clarity. Ripe cherries are carefully selected based on their sugar content to ensure peak sweetness. They are first sun-dried briefly like a natural, then rehydrated (soaked) to refine the profile, before being depulped and slowly dried again with controlled mucilage, similar to a honey process. This multi-stage approach is labour-intensive but results in exceptional balance and depth. The cup is delicate and expressive, opening with notes of peach tea and soft florals . A clean sugarcane sweetness runs through, with layers of stone fruit add gentle juiciness and depth as the cup cools. Light roasted to preserve its vibrancy, this coffee is bright, elegant, and structured, ideal for Pour-over, AeroPress, and other manual brews.

origin: Ate, Chikmagalur Marks A Special Milestone, The First Ha
description_raw: This extremely limited nanolot from Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur marks a special milestone, the first harvest of Pacamara on the estate. Known for its large bean size and distinctive cup profile, Pacamara as a varietal brings both intensity and elegance, making this release a rare opportunity to experience its character in a new terroir. The cherries undergo 42-hour anaerobic fermentation with nitrogen gas , creating an oxygen-free environment that enhances aromatic precision. The coffee is then depulped and washed , refining clarity, before being dried on raised beds for 19 days to build balance and structure. The result is a vibrant, fruit-forward profile, opening with crisp red apple and kiwi . A bright, tropical acidity is balanced by the delicate sweetness of starfruit , while honeysuckle florals bring a lifted, aromatic elegance. Best suited for filter brewing methods like Pour-over, French Press and AeroPress, where its clarity, brightness, and layered complexity can be fully appreciated.

description_raw: From Melkodige Estate, Chikmagalur , this Melkodige Intenso Yeast Naturals is a refined take on yeast-driven fermentation. Using a 72-hour Intenso Yeast Anaerobic Natural process , the coffee develops heightened aromatics and a clean, expressive structure that feels both modern and elegant. Roasted light, the cup is delicate and fragrant, led by floral notes of lavender and Earl Grey , followed by juicy blueberry sweetness and a bright hints of yuzu candy . The profile is balanced, and refreshing, with a soft acidity and a lingering, graceful finish. Best enjoyed black, this coffee truly shines on V60 and AeroPress , while also offering a gentle, nuanced cup on French Press or Moka Pot . A subtle yet expressive lot that highlights the harmony between fermentation technique and Chikmagalur terroir.

A method unique to India, where the beans undergo a monsooning process for a duration of 3 months near the Malabar coast where they are exposed to the moist monsoon winds to give them a unique flavour profile and in the process the beans swell up and fade resulting in a nutty and earthy coffee with reduced levels of acidity. This coffee is one of the world’s most sought after Indian coffees across the world, we have profiled this coffee as a medium roast to highlight the balance and sweetness of the coffee. Monsoon Malabar is a treat for the fresh press, mokapot and espresso brewers.

Presenting Dusk our versatile medium-dark cold brew blend, an amalgamation of two washed coffees which adds the body and chocolatiness and a monsooned coffee which makes the brew smooth & nutty with a malty finish. This blend delivers rich notes of dark chocolate, roasted nuts, and caramel. Perfect as a cold brew or espresso, Dusk offers a smooth, indulgent coffee experience that's sure to satisfy your taste buds . This blend can be consumed with or without milk.

origin: Ate, Chikmagalur , This Bold And Indulgent Lot — Ratnagi
description_raw: From the celebrated Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur , this bold and indulgent lot — Ratnagiri Rum Barrel Aged — pushes the boundaries of flavour through an innovative post-fermentation approach. After anaerobic natural processing, the coffee is aged in rum barrels , allowing it to absorb deep, spirit-led complexity while retaining its fruit-forward core. Roasted to a medium profile , the cup is rich and expressive, opening with lush notes of ripe Alphonso mango and black currant . As it cools, decadent tones of rum & coke emerge, rounded off by a smooth vanilla sweetness. The result is a layered, dessert-like cup with warmth, depth, and a lingering finish. Best enjoyed black to experience its full intensity, this coffee performs beautifully across AeroPress, French Press, and Moka Pot , while also offering a striking, unconventional expression on V60 . A daring and luxurious lot that showcases Ratnagiri’s spirit of experimentation and craftsmanship.

origin: The Sakleshpur Region Of Karnataka, These Washed Coffe
description_raw: Grown at elevation of 1050 MASL in the Sakleshpur region of Karnataka, these washed coffee’s from Harley Estate undergo a barrel ageing process in single malt whiskey barrels sourced from Amrut Distillers. This produces a cup which is fruity, boozy and sweet with notes of irish cream, green apple, stone fruit and hints of spice. The coffee is roasted to a medium level to increase the sweetness and balance the body & mallic acidity of the coffee. This coffee is suitable for espresso, pourover, aeropress and French press.

Back for its second year , this coffee from Ratnagiri Estate is unlike anything else. Made from red ripe cherries that are fermented for months inside whiskey barrels , it naturally absorbs the deep, aromatic character of the wood and the spirit. We roast it to a medium profile to highlight its rich, indulgent notes of single malt whiskey, cranberry, caramel, and plum cake . The result is a cup that’s bold yet balanced ,smooth enough to enjoy black, and rich enough to pair beautifully with milk. Whether brewed as an espresso, French press, or pour-over , this coffee delivers a comforting warmth and a hint of celebration in every sip.

Roasted medium-dark for espresso , this cup hits like a cozy dessert : Valencia Orange zest , roasted hazelnuts , and chocolate spread all rolled into one smooth finish. Perfect for your espresso machine, moka pot, AeroPress, or French press . All the taste. None of the jitters.

description_raw: ANIMAL PRINTED PACKS AVAILABLE IN 500 g ONLY Indian coffees are home to the best shade grown coffees in the world. It grows Arabica and Robusta coffees in the southern states where lush coffee plantations are heavily inter cropped with black pepper and ginger that bustle with honeybees and yield the finest coffee beans. Peaberry coffees are rare, comprising only 3-7% of the total crop. These pea-shaped, natural formations of the coffee bean are thought to form when several pistils get knocked off the coffee flower, causing only one seed to form inside the coffee fruit rather than two. Normally coffee beans grow two to a cherry, flat against each other but in about five percent of the worlds coffee a bean is found to be solo that's Peaberry. Because there's no way to tell from looking at the cherry whether there's a single or double bean inside, as a result Peaberry beans are hand picked and processed to be enjoyed separately. Tasting notes: At Devans, Arabica Peaberry is roasted in a way to create a mild strength of coffee, that is soft, smooth, highly aromatic and flavorful . origin: On - Chikmagalur, Karnataka Krishna Estate, Located In T
description_raw: Coffee Variety - Arabica Beans Post Harvest Process - Washed Roast level - Medium Region - Chikmagalur, Karnataka Krishna Estate, located in the Malnad region of Chikmagalur, at an elevation of 3600 to 3800 ft above sea level. The estate was developed by Krishnappa, the great-grandfather of the current custodians. The coffee is cultivated from Selection-3 and Selection-9 varieties developed at CCRI, Balehonnur, along with the recently planted Chandragiri variety of Arabica. The estate follows traditional growing and processing practices, aiming to minimize the use of residual fungicides by avoiding systemic fungicides and utilizing other preventive measures. Shade is provided by a variety of jungle trees, including Garige, Basri, Byne, Silver Oak, and Jackfruit while intercropping with pepper and areca nut has been introduced over the last two years. The coffee is picked in three stages, with ripe cherries selectively harvested, washed, and sun-dried on the estate’s home patio. Historically, women have played key roles behind the scenes, and it is encouraging to see them now taking leadership positions in the coffee industry. The sisters managing the estate describe their journey back to their roots as thrilling and are committed to contributing to the ecosystem through sustainable, ethically grown, and residue-free coffee It reminds us of : Whole Beans - Berries, Honey, Roasted Nuts, Medium Acidity, Full Body French Press - Honey, Dark Chocolate, Salted Caramel Popcorn, Low Acidity, Medium Body Pour Over / Drip Filter - Peach, Apricots, Candied Lime, Low Acidity, Full Body Mokapot / Percolator - Dark Chocolate, Hint of Blueberry, Medium Acidity, Medium Body Espresso - Cherry, Strawberry, Dark Chocolate, Low Acidity, Medium Body Aeropress - Cherry-Berries, Winey Aroma, Medium Acidity, Full Body

About the Process Traditional Naturals: In this traditional natural process, ripe coffee cherries are harvested and dried whole, with the skin and pulp left intact. As they dry, sugars and fruit compounds slowly ferment and infuse into the bean. The cherries are spread across patios or raised beds and turned regularly to prevent defects, until they reach a stable moisture level for hulling. This method produces coffees with a heavier body, greater sweetness, and pronounced fruity or wine-like character. About the Roast Medium Roast : At Subko, a Medium roast is one that is obtained by dropping the coffee lot at 201°-204°C. These roasts are generally of a sensory profile that is very smooth, caramel and complex tropical fruits. In terms of the Agtron scale, Subko's definition of medium lies between the points 60 to 74, with 74 being the lightest version of a medium roast, and 60 being the darkest version of the roast.

description_raw: This Friday, we gather at LoCol, Delhi for an evening that approaches the city as something we move through and converse with. The (Extra)Mural City: Street Art, Demos, and Public Space , a talk in collaboration with the St+Art Foundation and unLecture, looks at how street art changes the way we experience public space and how shared walls shape everyday urban life. Marking a decade of the Lodhi Art District, the session reflects on how creative interventions reshape neighborhoods, spark dialogue, and negotiate visibility, regulation, and ownership in contemporary cities. Date: Friday, 27th February 2026 Time: 6:30 PM – 8:00 PM Space: Diwan-i-khaas (Mezzanine Floor) Location: LoCol by Subko, Delhi What to expect from the talk: Over the past ten years, Delhi’s walls have become a living gallery. This unLecture defines street art and clarifies how it differs from graffiti, murals, public art, and community practices. It looks at its political origins, its relationship with democratic space, and how it activates overlooked neighborhoods while navigating gentrification and control. The session considers the city as both play and participant in everyday life, tracing how creative practices shape how neighborhoods are understood and inhabited. About the Speaker: Sanchita Khurana is an Assistant Professor in English at Mata Sundri College for Women, University of Delhi. Her research focuses on urban aesthetics, popular culture, street art, and theories of radical democracy. She studies how creative practices interact with the social and political life of contemporary cities, with particular attention to Delhi’s evolving public art landscape, including the Lodhi Art District. The session includes a Harissa Grilled Sandwich (Half: Cheese/Chicken) and any one espresso-based beverage of your choice. Please pick your preference during checkout.

Ratnagiri Estate – Thermal Shock Coffee Located in the hills of Chikkamagaluru in Karnataka, Ratnagiri Estate is one of India’s most progressive specialty coffee farms. Founded in 1927 by the Patre family , the estate gained global recognition after Ashok Patre introduced modern agronomy and experimental fermentation techniques to Indian coffee production. Today, Ratnagiri is known for producing high-quality Arabica coffees with innovative processing methods that push the boundaries of flavor in Indian specialty coffee. This lot is processed using the Thermal Shock method , an advanced fermentation technique where carefully selected coffee cherries undergo controlled anaerobic fermentation with specific microbes before being exposed to a rapid shift between hot and cold water baths . This sudden temperature change helps lock aromatic compounds and sugars inside the bean, intensifying sweetness, fruit complexity, and clarity in the cup. The coffee is then slowly dried on raised beds under carefully controlled conditions to preserve its vibrant profile. Roast: Light to Medium Roast Processing: Thermal Shock Coffee Notes: Expect a vibrant and expressive cup with tropical fruit, berry sweetness, and honey-like notes , balanced by bright acidity and a clean, lingering finish. Altitude - 1000-1200mt

The Kuttinkhan Estate deserves special mention for becoming the first of Kelachandra's estates to be Rainforest Alliance certified. A visit to this estate is an experience in permaculture – fine arabicas, pepper, turmeric, oranges, and lemons grow in harmony alongside a canopy of native Ficus trees, some of which are nearly 100 years old. The fallen leaves of the trees create a natural mulch in the soil, keeping the organic matter in the soil enriched. First established in the late 1800s, this estate was acquired by Kelachandra Coffee in 2017 and has since undergone replantation with the Chandragiri varietal, a prime Arabica coffee. Coffee Notes: Cinnamon and Nutmeg Spice. Winy and Tangy with a good body. Roast: Light to Medium Roast Processing: Anaerobic Anaerobic fermentation coffee is made by fermenting coffee cherries in sealed, oxygen-free tanks. Inside, yeasts and bacteria break down sugars, creating lactic acids and fruity compounds that give the coffee intense, wine-like, and tropical flavors. It’s a controlled and experimental process that produces highly distinct and complex cups, but requires precise temperature and pH monitoring to avoid over-fermentation.

During the late 19th century, while India was under British rule, coffee was regularly shipped to Europe. Coffee was exposed to the damp and humid monsoon conditions while it was stored on barges and transported from India to Europe. This caused the coffee beans to swell, become pale in color, and also altered their taste. In this way, Monsoon Malabar coffee was discovered. The raw beans are exposed to the annual monsoon humidity in India for around 3 to 4 months. This reduces the acidity of coffee beans and gives them a unique earthy flavor. Roast: Light to medium roast coffee Coffee Notes: This Microlot monsooned malabar coffee has Mellowness, Light bitter and good soft body after taste.

Brazil Cerrado Brazil is the largest coffee-growing country in the world, responsible for 30 percent of coffee grown worldwide. One of the most notable coffee regions in Brazil is Cerrado, in southwestern Minas Gerais. Cerrado is a vast tropical and subtropical biome that includes forests, marshlands and grassland. Covering more than 20 percent of Brazil, it is the largest savannah in South America. The name cerrado translates as closed, and the region remained so until the 1960s, when farmers began treating the soil. Over the years, the grasslands were transformed into agricultural and pasture land. Brazil Cerrado coffee is grown at altitudes of 900–1,250 meters above sea level. Most coffees are processed using natural and pulped-natural processes, meaning the coffee is dried with all or a large amount of fruit on the bean. Coffee Notes: This light roast coffee imparts hints of roasted Almonds and dry grapes. Indeed a delicacy for people who enjoy Espresso Roasts. SCA Brewing Foundation Course 17th APRIL 2026 The Brewing Foundation course offers a comprehensive introduction to the art and science of coffee brewing. Through both theory and hands-on practice, learners are guided through various brewing methods using a range of devices. This course is ideal for beginners and provides the fundamental skills and knowledge needed to craft delicious brewed coffee. What You'll Learn: 1. Coffee Knowledge : Understand Arabica vs. Robusta, processing methods, and best practices for coffee storage. 2. Brewing Methods & Equipment : Explore manual brewers like V60, French Press, and AeroPress, and learn how to use essential brewing tools. 3. Brewing Guidelines : Master the 7 key elements of brewing: ratio, grind, time, temperature, turbulence, water quality, and filter type. 4. Brewing Techniques : Practice percolation (V60), immersion (French Press), and hybrid (AeroPress) brewing styles. 5. Brew Analysis : Learn to evaluate your brew by analyzing its color, aroma, taste, and body. 6. Tastes Like - Toasted Cashews, Betel leaf and Cloves Roasting Profile - Espresso profile (Medium Roast) Process - Washed Varietal - Chandragiri Altitude - 1150 MASL Producer Name - Mr. Roshan Divaker Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - This washed Chandragiri lot was selectively hand-picked at peak ripeness and careful sun drying on raised beds. Roasters Note - We roasted this washed Chandragiri lot to highlight its warm, spice-forward character and nutty sweetness. The profile brings out notes of toasted cashews, betel leaf, and cloves, while maintaining a steady structure and smooth finish. Development was managed to enhance solubility for espresso and filter, without flattening the inherent aromatics of the variety and process.

Tastes Like - Spiced Mandarin Tea , Dried Apple and Cranberry Roasting Profile - Filter ( Light Roast ) Process - Naturals Varietal - SL 795 Altitude - 1050 MASL Producer Name - Mr. Sharan Gowda Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - This lot was fermented in our newly introduced bioreactor, a state-of-the-art fermentation system designed to ensure precise control and homogeneous fermentation. The coffees were placed in the bioreactor for 72 hours, where temperature, oxygen levels, and microbial activity were carefully managed. A specially selected yeast strain was introduced during fermentation to enhance and amplify the fruit-forward characteristics of the coffee. Once fermentation was complete, the coffee was removed from the bioreactor and dried slowly on raised beds, allowing the developed flavors to stabilize and fully express themselves in the final cup. Roasters Note - This coffee is a beautiful example of controlled fermentation done right. Processed in a state-of-the-art bioreactor over 72 hours with carefully managed temperature, oxygen, and a selected yeast strain, the result is an exceptionally clean yet expressive cup. Roasted for filter to highlight clarity and sweetness, it opens up with a vibrant spiced mandarin tea character, followed by layers of dried apple and a crisp cranberry finish. Bright, fruit-forward, and structured , a lot that feels both lively and refined.

Tastes Like - Sour Cherry, Stone Fruits, Sweet finish Roasting Profile - Filter ( Light Roast ) Process - Naturals Varietal - SLN 795 Altitude - 1350-1400 MASL Producer Name - Mrs. Hamsini Appadurai Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - After selective hand-picking, the coffees are fermented with a culture of lactobacillus and pichia for 27 hours. They are then slow-dried on raised beds for 20 days to ensure consistency and even airflow. Roasters Note - Roasted with a curve designed to highlight the coffee’s anaerobic character and fruit complexity. Expect a vibrant cup led by sour cherry acidity, layered stone fruit sweetness, and a clean, sweet finish with a smooth lingering aftertaste

Tastes Like - Watermelon, Orange Blossom, and Damson Plum Roasting Profile - Filter ( Light Roast ) Process - Carbonic Maceration Naturals Varietal - SL 795 + SL 6 Altitude - 1050 MASL Producer Name - Mr. Sharan Gowda Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - Ripe coffee cherries are carefully handpicked from  Dodda kere Patte, at a Brix level of 24. The cherries are then sealed in stainless steel tanks and pressurized with carbon dioxide for 72 hours, creating an anaerobic environment that initiates carbonic maceration. During this stage, intracellular fermentation occurs within the intact cherries, intensifying fruit-forward characteristics and enhancing aromatic complexity. After fermentation, the cherries are removed from the tanks and slowly dried on raised beds, preserving clarity, sweetness, and vibrant fruity flavors in the cup. Roasters Note - We roasted this carbonic maceration lot with a focus on clarity and fruit expression. The profile brings out its watermelon-like juiciness and orange blossom aromatics, supported by a deeper damson plum sweetness. Development was kept controlled to retain acidity and structure while preserving a light, refreshing finish.

Tastes Like - Green Apple, Muskmelon and Rounded mouthfeel Roasting Profile - Espresso profile (Medium Roast) Process - Washed Varietal - S 795 Altitude - 1470 MASL Producer Name - Mr. Thouqeer Ahamed Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - At our estate, every coffee bean carries the story of a season shaped by nature, care, and tradition. Coffee cultivation is not just farming for us-it is a craft passed down through generations. From the first rains that awaken the blossoms to the final drying of cherries under the sun, each step is guided with patience and precision. Roasters Note - This lot was developed for espresso to bring out its crisp green apple acidity and subtle muskmelon sweetness, while maintaining a rounded and balanced mouthfeel. The roast profile was tuned to preserve clarity and fruit expression without compromising body, making it versatile both as a straight shot and in milk-based beverages.

Tastes Like - Java Plum, Banana, Elderflower Roasting Profile - Filter ( Light Roast ) Process - Honey Sun Dried Varietal - Sl 9 Altitude - 1600-1700 MASL Producer Name - Mrs. Hamsini Appadurai Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - After pulping, the coffee cherries undergo a 27-hour anaerobic fermentation in sealed tanks. Following fermentation, the coffee is heaped for three days and then slow-dried on raised beds over a period of 22 days. This carefully controlled process enhances clarity, sweetness, and complexity in the final cup. Roasters Note - Smooth and sweet with notes of Java plum, banana, and a light elderflower lift. Clean and balanced on V60 with a soft, lingering sweetness.

description_raw: Tastes Like - Pomegranate, Pink Guava and Golden Raisins Roasting Profile - Filter ( Light Roast ) Process - Saccharomyces 72hrs Naturals Varietal - Sl 9 Altitude - 1280 MASL Producer Name - Aveen and Yogita Rodrigues Harvest Year - 2024-2025 Coffee Producers Note - R ed, fully ripe cherries with a Brix level above 22 are selectively handpicked and carefully cleaned using a water bath to remove impurities and lighter fruit. The cherries then undergo anaerobic fermentation in sealed drums for 72 hours, allowing complex flavours to develop. Post-fermentation, they are transferred to raised wooden drying beds and dried slowly under shade nets. During this stage, the cherries are regularly raked to ensure even and consistent drying. Once fully dried, they are packed into gunny bags and rested for 60 days, allowing the flavours to stabilise and mature before further processing. Roasters Note - We’ve taken this coffee light to preserve its vibrancy and showcase the fruit character developed during fermentation. Expect a bright, expressive cup with juicy acidity and a clean, lingering sweetness. In the cup: Pomegranate leads with a fresh, winey brightness, followed by soft pink guava and a rounded golden raisin sweetness on the finish. The body is smooth and supple, with a crisp yet balanced aftertaste. Best enjoyed when brewed clean and slightly cooler to let the fruit open up gradually.

Minimum resting period Filter 6 Days | Espresso 14 Days A song that pairs well About the region / estate : This lot was sourced from St. Joseph Estate , situated in the hills of Perumalmalai in Kodaikanal , a region often referred to as the Princess of Hill Stations . The estate sits at approximately 4000 feet above sea level , where cooler mountain temperatures allow for slower cherry maturation and a more concentrated sugar development in the fruit. The coffee is composed of Catimore, Chandragiri, and SLN9 cultivars, varieties well suited to the high elevation conditions of the region. Cherries were harvested at peak ripeness and processed as sun-dried naturals , using controlled dehydrator technology to carefully regulate moisture loss during the drying phase. This method allows for a stable fermentation environment while preserving the integrity of the fruit sugars and aromatic compounds. Roasters thought : During roasting, we aimed to highlight the coffee’s natural fruit density and creamy structure . The profile follows a light roast approach with elevated airflow and a development ratio of approximately 14% , allowing for clarity of flavour while maintaining the underlying sweetness and tactile body.

This blend releases an aroma of red ripe berries immediately post grinding it. It can be enjoyed both with and without milk especially a cortado. As roasters the creation of this blend took us over 3 months, after several roasting profiles & blending lots different ways to eventually do over a dozen espresso trials. Expect an invigorating aroma, sweet rich espresso and a final cup full of red berry sweetness. origin: Igin Chikmagalur, Karnataka Varietal & Altitude Selectio
description_raw: #2 ROASTERS ART | ROASTERS ESPRESSO 3.0 Well rounded Heavy Body with a base of sweet & creamy milk chocolate. Suitable for all brew methods. Serving as House blend at Grey Soul Coffee Roasters, Koregoan Park, Pune. Origin Chikmagalur, Karnataka Varietal & Altitude Selection 5B, 9 & Chandragiri grown at 3800 - 4100 Feet Sensory Evaluation Almonds, Chocolate buttercream and Deep Sweetness from Ripe Red berries. Dry Aroma Hazelnut, Cacao & Dates Wet Aroma Almond, Berry Jam & Milk Chocolate Roast Profile Low Temperature Fed Slightly above Med Roast, High DTR & Extended Maillard Phase. A different approach to roasting is what we adapted to this lot and is what we call extended maillard technique. In this particular way, we start off the roast at a lower temperature and gradually increase post the dry end phase which allows the coffee to roast longer during the browning phase thus producing the sweet acidity, denser crema and long lasting finish. origin: Grown On The Lush Slopes Of The Ratnagiri Estate
description_raw: Grown on the lush slopes of the Ratnagiri estate in Karnataka, this medium-roast coffee showcases the depth and elegance of its terroir. Carefully hand-picked and expertly roasted, the beans develop a rich, comforting profile. In the cup, you’ll discover deep notes of dried plum and raisin, bringing a natural sweetness and gentle fruit complexity. These flavors are grounded by smooth cocoa undertones that add warmth and balance. The medium roast enhances body and sweetness while preserving clarity, resulting in a well-rounded, indulgent coffee that’s both comforting and refined.

coffee_name: Single Origin Easy Coffee Bags (Box of 10)
origin: Carefully Sourced From One Exceptional Farm
description_raw: Get ready to savor the vibrant, fruity notes of our Single-Origin Coffee, carefully sourced from one exceptional farm. We traveled far and wide to find the perfect beans, ensuring top quality and unique flavors. Each bean is roasted to perfection to bring out its balanced, fruity nuances. Enjoy a cup that's as special as you are, and start your morning with a delightful boost of pure coffee happiness!

coffee_name: Vienna Roast Easy Coffee Bags (Box of 10)
description_raw: Start your day with the deep, rich flavor of our Vienna Roast Coffee. This dark roast strikes the perfect balance between smooth and bold, giving you just the right kick to tackle whatever comes your way. Enjoy the cozy notes of chocolate and caramel in every sip, making your morning coffee a delightful and energizing experience. Wake up, feel great, and power through your day with Vienna Roast Easy Coffee!

4 Monsoon Malabar bags 3 Vienna Roast bags 3 Single Origin bags Indulge in a journey of taste with our Assorted Coffee Box, featuring a delightful trio of flavors. Each bag is a testament to craftsmanship, from the bold richness of Vienna Roast to the exotic allure of Monsoon Malabar and the nuanced elegance of Single Origin. Perfectly roasted and packed to preserve freshness, this box promises a coffee experience that's diverse, satisfying, and always memorable. Discover your favorite brew or enjoy them all—because every cup tells a story of flavor and passion.

Every sip of this 100% Arabica coffee is deliciously rich. Relax or recharge with the smooth, balanced brew of our medium roast specialty coffee that you can make any way you like. How about a splash of coconut water for a tropical Cafe Colada? Or a bit of orange juice for a Cold Fashioned? If you prefer something colder, add ice for a classic Iced Coffee.
Sip your coffee the traditional way with Third Wave Coffee’s Brass Dabra Set. This elegant set celebrates South Indian coffee culture, making every cup feel special and authentic.

coffee_name: Single Origin Easy Coffee Bags( Box of 5)
origin: Carefully Sourced From One Exceptional Farm
description_raw: Get ready to savor the vibrant, fruity notes of our Single-Origin Coffee, carefully sourced from one exceptional farm. We traveled far and wide to find the perfect beans, ensuring top quality and unique flavors. Each bean is roasted to perfection to bring out its balanced, fruity nuances. Enjoy a cup that's as special as you are, and start your morning with a delightful boost of pure coffee happiness!

coffee_name: Monsoon Malabar Easy Coffee Bags (Box of 5)
description_raw: Our Monsoon Malabar coffee is an homage to a historical process originating from the long sea journeys in the days of the British Raj. Each cup is packed with bold flavours, complemented by strong, nutty, earthy notes. Sip on this for a perfectly versatile cup that can be enjoyed any time of the day. Our suggestion? Keep a second Easy Coffee Bag of our Monsoon Malabar coffee handy because you’ll definitely want more!

coffee_name: Vienna Roast Easy Coffee Bags (Box of 5)
description_raw: Start your day with the deep, rich flavor of our Vienna Roast Coffee. This dark roast strikes the perfect balance between smooth and bold, giving you just the right kick to tackle whatever comes your way. Enjoy the cozy notes of chocolate and caramel in every sip, making your morning coffee a delightful and energizing experience. Wake up, feel great, and power through your day with Vienna Roast Easy Coffee!

origin: Iful Chikmagalur Region Of Karnataka, We Are Proud Produ
description_raw: Situated in the beautiful Chikmagalur region of Karnataka, we are proud producers of hand-picked and sun-dried Arabica coffee. Our coffee plants grow alongside pepper, cacao, and cardamom, creating a vibrant blend of flavors. When you savor a cup of our coffee, you'll experience the delightful combination of sweet honey and raisin. And to add a touch of fruity goodness, there's a juicy peach note that perfectly balances the overall taste. It's a coffee that's carefully crafted to deliver a truly satisfying and enjoyable experience.

origin: S Of Baba Budan Giri Hills
description_raw: Embark on a remarkable journey through the rich heritage of coffee cultivation in the hallowed grounds of Baba Budan Giri hills. This renowned destination, named after the legendary merchant Baba Budan, who deftly transported precious coffee seeds from Yemen, stands as the embodiment of India's esteemed coffee culture. Immerse yourself in our exceptional roast, where you will discover a delightful interplay of flavors. Experience the gentle sweetness of juicy passionfruit balanced by the lively brightness of pineapple. As the temperature gradually descends, a captivating essence of richer molasses emerges, offering a truly indulgent sensation. This coffee is meticulously crafted through a natural processing method, wherein the coffee beans are dried alongside the cherry, resulting in a remarkable symphony of complex, fruity, and sweet flavors. Only the finest, fully ripened cherries are meticulously handpicked, expertly sorted, and sun-dried on African raised beds, ensuring a pristine and flawless quality.

Experience the rich essence of our Monsoon Malabar coffee, a tribute to age-old traditions from the British Raj's seafaring days. This brew is an earthy symphony of bold flavors, infused with the warmth of aromatic spices and deep, dark chocolate notes. Perfectly balanced for any time of day, it’s a cup you’ll want to savor again and again. Our tip? Keep a second bag close—you won’t be able to resist a refill.

Inspired by the classic South Indian coffee, our blend is a bold tribute to tradition. The rich, burnt caramel notes of Arabica Washed coffee perfectly complement the smooth, syrupy texture of Robusta Natural, creating a robust yet comforting flavor. With hints of milk chocolate and roasted almonds, this blend shines whether paired with milk and sugar, as a strong espresso, or brewed in a Moka Pot.

origin: Ka'S Nilgiris, This Exquisite Dark Roast Is A True In
description_raw: Hailing from the misty green hills of Karnataka's Nilgiris, this exquisite dark roast is a true indulgence. With rich notes of toffee, roasted hazelnut, and the subtle crunch of cocoa nibs, each sip offers a full-bodied experience with a bittersweet undertone. Enjoy this decadent brew and let it whisk you away to a sunny day at a cozy Parisian café.

Our house blend might just remind you of dessert, and we’re perfectly okay with that. With bold notes of zesty orange, rich chocolate, and sweet brown sugar, this coffee is big-bodied, well-structured, and deeply complex. It’s what keeps our team at Third Wave Coffee going strong. Potent and flavorful on its own, or decadently indulgent with milk or cream, every sip is a delightful experience.

Discover the richness of our Vienna Roast, a smooth, dark blend that offers a decadent combination of flavors. Indulge in the deep, bittersweet taste of dark chocolate, complemented by the sweet warmth of maple syrup and the subtle crunch of toasted walnut. Crafted for a refined coffee experience, it’s a perfect pick for those who crave a bold yet silky-smooth cup.

coffee_name: Maillard’s Dream – Kerehaklu 62H Mosto Culture Naturals – Fine Robusta
description_raw: Maillard’s Dream celebrates the transformation that happens when fermentation innovation meets precision roasting. Named after the Maillard reaction — the browning process responsible for building caramelized, nutty, and baked flavor compounds in coffee — this lot was designed to amplify those sensory cues. At Kerehaklu Estate, Pranoy Thipaiah pushed Robusta processing forward using a mosto-cultured fermentation, reintroducing active microbes from previous fermentations to intensify sugar conversion and aromatic complexity. This layered foundation translated beautifully in the roaster, where controlled heat development unlocked notes of butter cookies, malt, cashew, and pastry. The result is a rich, textured cup that bridges science, craft, and flavor — proving once again that progressive processing and thoughtful roasting can redefine what Robusta is capable of becoming.

At Kerehaklu Estate, Pranoy Thipaiah continues to refine his expertise with cultured fermentations, using selected starters to guide flavor development with precision and consistency. These cultures enhance aromatic clarity, shape acidity, and unlock subtle floral complexity that rewards brewers who enjoy dialing in extraction and exploring nuance. Controlled polyhouse drying further elevates quality by protecting the coffee from environmental fluctuations and ensuring slow, even moisture reduction for greater stability and sweetness. Our light filter roast was designed to let these attributes shine — allowing florals to sparkle alongside bright acidity, while a clean medium mouthfeel preserves clarity and definition in the cup.

coffee_name: Pichia Parables  – Harley 36H Pichia Yeast Naturals
description_raw: Yeast-driven fermentations have reshaped how flavor develops in coffee, with each strain influencing acidity, sweetness, and aromatic complexity in its own distinct way. Pichia Parables explores this idea through a controlled Pichia yeast fermentation that highlights clarity and layered fruit expression. At Harley Estate, experimentation remains central — pushing boundaries with innovative processing methods that reveal new dimensions of origin character. We employed a deliberately slow and gradual roast profile, extending development time to deepen caramelisation and encourage complex sugar transformation, which in turn enhances sweetness, body, and nuance. The result is a syrupy, fruit-forward espresso with a remarkably sweet but balanced profile.

Kraken Jam is here. The follow-up to Dragon Jam — and yes, it’s every bit as wild. From the exceptional collection of naturals crafted by Navin & Ashok Rajes at Orchardale Estate, this coffee is crafted for espresso lovers who enjoy bold, juicy, and unapologetically indulgent shots. It brews bold, hits with layered fruit sweetness, and leaves behind that sticky, jammy finish we all chase. If Dragon Jam lived on your bar, Kraken Jam belongs there too. This is the kind of coffee that rewards curiosity — tweak your ratios, play with extraction, pull it short or stretch it out. It holds up beautifully and keeps giving back. For those who love syrupy shots, dessert-like cups, and coffees that feel larger than life — this one’s for you.

coffee_name: Sweet Illusions – BEWILD Permaculture 180H Anoxic Naturals – Fine Robusta
description_raw: Sweet Illusions is where Robusta decides to break the rules — and we’re here for it. Grown at BEWILD Coffee’s Poomale Estate under long-term permaculture farming, this lot turns expectation on its head with delicate florals and lasting sweetness that feel almost impossible for the species. Our omni roast lets it shine everywhere: V60, AeroPress, espresso, milk drinks — take your pick. Jasmine and red mace spice in a Robusta? Yes, really. This is coffee for brewers who love a plot twist. Swap your usual cup for Sweet Illusions and prepare to rethink what Robusta is capable of.

coffee_name: The Nut Job – Mooleh Manay 120H Carbonic Naturals – Fine Robusta
description_raw: The Nut Job marks South India Coffee Company’s latest Robusta experiment — an extended 120-hour carbonic macerated natural that delivers a standout nut-driven profile with delicate floral aromatics. This lot demonstrates how far Robusta has evolved, offering depth and nuance once considered out of reach for the species. We continue to seek coffees that merge Robusta’s signature richness with the complexity unlocked through thoughtful fermentation, and this release stands as compelling proof of what the future of Robusta can be.

origin: E In Chikmagalur, Crafted In Partnership With Our Long-S
description_raw: Currant Affairs is our vibrant, berry-forward showcase lot from Karadykan Estate in Chikmagalur, crafted in partnership with our long-standing producer partners at Sangameshwar Coffee Estates. Fermented with unrefined natural sugars, this coffee bursts with tangy berry sweetness and a smooth, nutty finish—an expressive cup that shines equally in espresso and manual brews. Our omni roast leans toward a balanced medium, unlocking layered sweetness and complexity while softening any sharp edges for a clean, easy-drinking experience. We’re proud to continue our collaboration with Sangameshwar, a producer that consistently pushes quality forward while championing community well-being. Their commitment spans from improved processing innovations to meaningful investments in worker housing, education, and sustainable initiatives like hydroelectric energy for pulping. Currant Affairs celebrates this shared vision—exceptional coffee rooted in people, progress, and experimentation.

We’re excited to welcome a new producer to the Naivo family: Manohar Shetty of Indravathi Estate. This lot was processed in collaboration with South India Coffee Company and profiled as a versatile espresso roast that performs reliably across both black and milk beverages. The cup brings together dried fruit sweetness, chocolate depth and a thread of subtle florals in the aroma, creating a balanced and confident flavour structure. It is designed to be a dependable everyday coffee with consistency across brews. The profile shines through immersion methods such as Aeropress and French Press, where it delivers bold flavour and a satisfying mouthfeel. It also pairs exceptionally well with the South Indian Filter, producing an aromatic, rich and familiar style of filter coffee.

From the House of SICC Labs comes a precise and authentic expression of the honey sun-dried process in India. Bold and sweet with a rich mouthfeel, this lot presents a predominantly chocolate-driven profile supported by a persistent underlying sweetness and a measured hint of bitterness that completes the cup. Designed to excel in milk-based beverages, it cuts cleanly through oat, almond, and dairy milk alike, delivering its signature chocolate and caramel character with clarity and strength.

Berry Dawn from Baarbara Estate is dual-fermented natural sun-dried lot, showcasing a spectrum of grape and berry notes shaped through meticulous two-stage fermentation. This process enhances mouthfeel while preserving clarity and complexity, reflecting Sreeraksha’s innovative approach to processing. Our omni roast highlights the coffee’s versatility, delivering a creamy, full-bodied espresso and equally refined, sweet pour-overs. With its jammy texture, crisp acidity, and layered fruit expression, Berry Dawn captures both precision in processing and complexity in the cup.

origin: Lush Bababudangiri Range, Baarbara Estate, Operated By
description_raw: The pineapple-fermented Arabica from Baarbara Estate has been one of our bestsellers over the past two years. This year’s harvest takes on a new identity in our showcase collection as Tropical Splash, with a roast profile fine-tuned to push the boundaries of espresso brewing. Nestled in the lush Bababudangiri Range, Baarbara Estate, operated by fourth-generation producer Sreeraksha Pournesh, has made groundbreaking advances in post-harvest processing. Playful yet precise fermentation with pineapple introduces a vivid new layer of sweetness to the coffee. The result is a cup that captures the essence of the tropics — sweet, tangy, and lively. Crafted for brewers who seek character in every sip, Tropical Splash delivers a lipsmacking espresso and a sweet, refreshing cold brew, offering a memorable journey into the possibilities of coffee co-fermentation with fruit.

origin: From Chikmagalur, A Women-Led Enterprise Run By Pranathi
description_raw: This washed lot comes from Kolli Berri Estate in Mudigere, 30 km from Chikmagalur, a women-led enterprise run by Pranathi Shetty. The cup is clean, uniform, and marked by bold flavors that cut through with clarity and balance. Designed for everyday drinking, it carries both strength and refinement—dependable yet distinctive.

coffee_name: Dragon Jam – Kolli Berri Anaerobic Naturals
description_raw: Dragon Jam from Kolli Berri Estate is the first showcase coffee of the 2025 harvest—an explosion of funk and fruit. Run by Pranathi Shetty, Kolli Berri is a women-led enterprise in Mudigere, 30 km from Chikmagalur. This lot brims with sweetness, layered fruit depth, and a creamy mouthfeel. Roasted to a medium profile, it thrives across espresso, pourovers, and cold brew.

Ashok Patre bends tradition by bringing an Arabica mosto culture into Robusta processing—engineering a cup that is refined, complex, and confident enough to rival any specialty Arabica. Mosto is the liquid drawn from fermented coffee cherries, packed with wild yeasts, bacteria, and enzymes that act as a catalyst to build layered flavor during fermentation. At Naivo, we have long prophesied the untapped potential of Robusta and the infinite flavors it holds to expand the coffee universe. This lot is that prophecy made real—bold, articulate, and ready to tell you a striking new story of flavor.

Some coffees born from experimental fermentations have earned the label “dirty” from traditionalists, pushing producers to fine-tune processes that balance sweetness with clarity. This lot from the Ratnagiri Vault shows how far Ashok Patre has taken that challenge. His work with microbial cultures, controlled fermentations, and precise drying has steadily shifted Ratnagiri’s output—from wild, funky, boundary-pushing cups to more nuanced, elegant expressions that remain just as memorable. Here, sweetness is immaculate and clarity uncompromised. Every note is sharply defined, every layer distinct. Built for espresso, it offers a fruit-forward cup—syrupy, sweet, but balanced. Its clarity translates seamlessly into refined pourovers, while its richness anchors deeply satisfying cold brews.

From the inventive mind of Ashok Patre emerges a definitive statement in florality—now synonymous with Ratnagiri Estate’s most celebrated expressions. Renowned for his rigorously researched and precisely executed post-harvest methods, Patre has consistently redefined the sensory possibilities of Indian coffee. In this lot, a 48-hour anaerobic fermentation with his own lab-cultured microbes delivers a cup of remarkable elegance and aromatic clarity. It is yet another masterstroke from a producer whose work continues to intrigue, challenge, and delight the most discerning coffee connoisseurs.

Breaking from convention, this lot channels Ashok Patre’s experimental mastery into a strikingly floral profile that stands apart from the sweet, winey, and fruity leanings typical of India’s innovative fermentations. Every stage of the post-harvest journey at Ratnagiri reflects Mr. Patre’s hallmark precision and consistency, giving roasters the confidence of a clearly defined cup year after year. Distinct and versatile, it shines in pourovers, bursts with character through the Aeropress, and delivers layered depth in a French Press — a compelling case for its place in this year’s dedicated Ratnagiri Vault collection.

Ashok Patre has invested heavily in precision processing, going as far as building a dedicated dark room to dry coffee in complete isolation from external elements. By removing sunlight and stabilizing airflow, the dark room slows drying, protects fragile compounds, and deepens flavor development. This lot begins with thermal-shocked, LAB-inoculated cherry fermentation—an approach that heightens control and pushes fruit expression into bold territory. The result is a cup of remarkable complexity: sweet, syrupy, and saturated with layers of ripe fruit. As espresso, it delivers blockbuster intensity—creamy, fruit-forward, and lingering. It shines equally in immersion brews like French Press and Aeropress, while its vivid fruit character and dense sweetness make it a prime candidate for inventive cold brew experiments.

origin: This Aa Washed Lot Comes From Mondul Estate
description_raw: This AA washed lot comes from Mondul Estate, a 211-hectare farm located in northern Tanzania’s Arusha region — within Maasai territory and managed under the Burka Estates group. Established in 1931 and acquired in 2007, Mondul is known for its structured operations, high elevation, and consistent processing standards. Washed and dried on raised beds using spring water from the estate, this lot reflects the hallmarks of Tanzanian coffees: floral aromatics, tangy-sweet acidity, and a clean, tea-like finish. Our filter roast is intentionally light, with just enough development to preserve origin clarity while unlocking balanced sweetness. Mondul represents a model of controlled production — from farm management to cup profile — delivering a coffee that’s precise, articulate, and rooted in process.

The second Ethiopian release of the year comes through Testi Coffee—this time, a natural from Denbi Uddo in the Guji Zone of Oromia. Guji coffees are known for showcasing the wilder side of Ethiopian terroir, and this lot is no exception. Comprised up of semi-wild heirloom varieties, it strikes a clean balance between acidity and mouthfeel, with a vibrant mix of fruit and floral notes. Our omni roast opens up a wide range of possibilities for both filter and espresso, encouraging brewers to explore and extract unique, unexpected profiles. It’s layered, approachable, and just familiar enough to feel like home for seasoned Ethiopian coffee lovers.

The superstar coffee that lit up our roster for many years is finally back—and it’s here to elevate your brewing game. Floral, wild, and crisp with juicy acidity, our latest washed lot from Idido, Yirgacheffe (pronounced yeer-ga-CHUFF-eh) in Ethiopia meets all the high expectations we typically set for Ethiopian coffees. If you’re weary of funky fermentations and on the lookout for clean cups that showcase the unique character of terroir, this coffee is sure to become your muse. We’ve settled on a light to medium roast that ensures the inherent terroir shines through, while the cup boasts enough sweetness to keep you musing—and coming back for more.

From one of El Salvador’s most respected coffee families, this microlot release captures the clarity and elegance of the Geisha varietal, grown in the nutrient-rich volcanic soils of the Santa Ana region. Finca El Reforma is located at 1,300–1,500 MASL, and is owned and operated by the Alvarez family, whose coffee legacy spans over four generations. This coffee is light-roasted specifically for filter brewing methods like pourovers and AeroPress to ensure the balance, aromatics, and clean sweetness are most pronounced. Expect a cup that reflects both varietal and origin—refined, structured, and thoughtfully produced from start to finish.

origin: Washed Arabica From Seethargundu Estate That Belongs To The Poabs Organic Estate
description_raw: Our first lot from Kerala is a washed Arabica from Seethargundu Estate that belongs to the POABS Organic Estates group. Nestled in the cool, picturesque hills of Nelliyampathy, this estate is located within the majestic Sahyadri mountain range, renowned for its rich biodiversity and recognized as one of the world’s biodiversity hotspots by the IUCN. The Nelliyampathy region, just 65 km from Palakkad, boasts fertile valleys lined with tea, coffee, cardamom, and other plantations that thrive in its ideal climate, characterized by annual rainfall of around 4000 mm and temperatures ranging from 14°C to 30°C. Seethargundu Estate stands out not only for its high-quality coffee but also for its breathtaking views of the valley, offering visitors an unforgettable panorama.

origin: These Beans Were Aged Expertly In Rum Barrels At Harley Estate
description_raw: These beans were aged expertly in rum barrels at Harley Estate and profiled by our roasters to create an elegant symphony between notes of amla, orange peel and walnut. Contrary to typical barrel aged coffees, this one is surprisingly balanced and expresses itself impressively without the need to overwhelm your palate. Use it to fuel your manual brew experiments and don’t be afraid to pull espresso shots and even bring in the milk. Our omni roast finds the right degree of neutrality that makes this coffee suitable for most brewing methods.

Here’s another treat for Robusta enthusiasts from innovative producer Ashish Rao, showcasing the endless potential of Robustas from the Coorg region. This is a versatile coffee that adapts to diverse brewing styles, whether it’s a bold French Press brew, a refined pour-over, a quick brew through the Aeropress, or a simple brew with a Channi if you’ve got no fancy equipment at home. Our tailored roast profile for honey sundried Robustas brings out the sweetness in this coffee intertwined with distinct spice notes. The rich body and mild acidity are evident making this a delight for lovers of robust, punchy coffees without overwhelming bitterness in the aftertaste.

coffee_name: Cashews & Barley Sugar – Kerehaklu 25H Pichia Naturals – Fine Robusta
description_raw: Pranoy Thipaiah’s expertise in microbial biology could serve to displace the fear every specialty coffee enthusiast associates with Robusta. His use of fermentation with Pichia yeast delivers us with another pleasant surprise that comes in the form of a very fine Robusta that’s as buttery and creamy as it is nutty and sweet. With medium-low acidity, a rich, viscous tactile and undertones of spice, we have a coffee here that redefines our understanding of Robustas and displays the potential they have to reveal new, unexplored flavorscapes. This one’s a sure winner for espressos but our tailored omni roast makes it a great experimental coffee for Moka Pot and South Indian Filter too. India is world-renowned for her washed Robustas, particularly in espresso-forward consumer countries, but with evolving fermentation practices, our Robusta naturals continue to surprise us with every passing season. We implore you to experiment with this one. You won’t regret it!

Our lot of naturals from Dunduga Estate is a balanced fruit bomb that works well with a diverse range of brewing methods including pourovers, aeropress, espresso and cold brew. This is our first year of collaboration with D S Raghu and his wife Shanthala who come from a long and rich heritage of coffee production at Dunduga Estate in the Mudigere region. Established in the 1950s, coffee at Dunduga grows alongside Pepper, Areca and jungle trees including Jackfruit, Mahogany, Rose wood, Mango, Red and White Cedar.

This washed coffee from Dunduga Estate boasts of a rich, strong, and smoky profile reminiscent of Turkish Tobacco. This is our first collaboration with D S Raghu and his wife Shanthala who come from a long and rich heritage of coffee production at Dunduga Estate in the Mudigere region. Established in the 1950s, coffee at Dunduga grows alongside Pepper, Areca and jungle trees including Jackfruit, Mahogany, Rose wood, Mango, Red and White Cedar.

We’ve made significant progress in our exploration of Fine Robustas, aiming to showcase the high quality of Robusta coffee produced in India. Most Indian Robusta is exported to Europe and Australia, while much of what stays within the country is utilized by instant coffee manufacturers and roasters focusing on mass-produced commercial blends for espresso and South Indian filter coffee. With revolutionary advancements in farming, fermentation, and post-harvest processing, our producers are generating considerable excitement in the Robusta space.

origin: N Of Sakleshpur, Renowned For Its Rich Volcanic Soil An
description_raw: In collaboration with the skilled producers at Harley Estate, nestled in the picturesque region of Sakleshpur, renowned for its rich volcanic soil and unique microclimate, we proudly present India’s famed Robusta Kaapi Royale. This exquisite coffee showcases a perfect harmony of flavor and aroma. Meticulously handpicked at peak ripeness, only the finest Robusta beans are selected, guaranteeing an unparalleled level of quality and consistency.

Our Decaf comes from CR3-Kaffeeveredelung M. Hermsen in Bremen, Germany, ensuring the highest quality and taste without the caffeine. Our roast profile is finely tuned to highlight the nuanced flavors that make for an exceptional decaf. With a delightful balance and remarkable versatility, this coffee performs beautifully across multiple brewing methods, from French press to espresso. Each cup reveals a rich and rounded experience that transcends typical decaf offerings, providing a satisfying and flavorful journey for any coffee enthusiast who desires the experience of specialty coffee without caffeine.

As we navigate the expansive and intricate landscape of specialty coffees, characterized by advanced fermentation techniques, we find a deep appreciation for the traditional elements of washed coffee lots. Discovering a washed lot with distinctive characteristics and remarkably sweet but balanced flavors often influences our choice for a daily coffee staple. Our association with Unakki Estate commenced through ongoing discussions with Utsav Gowda, an enthusiastic young farmer passionately managing the operations at the estate. An aspiring lawyer balancing his academic pursuits with the challenges of safeguarding his coffee crop from unpredictable rains, Utsav embodies the promising future of Indian coffee.

Barrel aged coffee can be two things – a well-crafted gimmick or a well-crafted specialty coffee. And obviously, our focus is on achieving the latter. It’s a difficult coffee to roast but, when done right, it can reveal a completely different spectrum of flavors. The combination of woody undertones with boozy flavors may not sit perfectly on all palates. But if you’re an adventurer who appreciates intense surprises, this is a coffee you just shouldn’t miss!

origin: Testament To Our Enduring Partnership With Producer Utsav Gowda Of Unakki Estate
description_raw: Unakki Dark Honey is a testament to our enduring partnership with producer Utsav Gowda of Unakki Estate. Following the success of Unakki’s washed lot, a bestseller celebrated by our customers for its clean, consistent, and classic flavor profile, Utsav continues to refine his processing techniques. This year, he presents us with a remarkable Dark Honey, meticulously curated for optimal performance in espresso. With its rich and complex profile, this coffee exemplifies Utsav’s dedication to innovation and quality. This release reinforces our commitment to fostering a long-term relationship with Unakki Estate, ensuring a future of extraordinary coffees for our community.

Picture this: the thunder cracks, the rain pours down in torrents, and you’re nestled in a cozy corner, clutching a steaming cup of coffee that holds within it the essence of the monsoon season. Welcome to the world of Monsoon Malabar coffee, a truly captivating brew that doesn’t just tell a story; it transports you right into the heart of the South Indian monsoons with every sip. The origins of Monsoon Malabar lie in an age-old tale of shipping voyages and climatic alchemy. Back in the days when coffee was transported from India to Europe in wooden ships, the beans would undergo a metamorphosis during the monsoon months. The beans, exposed to the moist sea air and relentless monsoon winds, would swell up, turning pale gold and developing a unique flavour profile. This transformation was so beloved by coffee aficionados that a method was devised to replicate it on land, thus birthing the modern Monsoon Malabar.

The Chandragiri varietal when put through the washed process is characterized by clean and bright acidity complemented by nutty and tangy notes and a very subtle floral aroma. This coffee comes from one of our earliest producer partners – Balanoor Plantations – who are pioneers of washed coffees in India and have been exporting some of the finest Arabicas to specialty markets in Europe for several decades.

origin: We Have Always Enjoyed Visiting Their Farm
description_raw: With a delicate combination of silky texture, bright citrus blossom notes, and hints of honeydew melon and golden raisins, this coffee yields a truly memorable cup. The dedication and commitment of Mr. Ashok Kuriyan and his son Rohan are evident in every cup. As old friends and long-time collaborators, we have always enjoyed visiting their farms, working with them, and roasting their delightful coffees.

origin: S Of Chikmagalur, This Place Is More Than A Commercial O
description_raw: Our search for the immaculate espresso began when we were embraced by the warm welcome of Ramdev and his parents Shantha and Nagesh as we drove through the gates of Bettadamalali Estate in early 2023. A pristine farm nestled in the Baba Budan Giri hills of Chikmagalur, this place is more than a commercial operation – it is a garden of nature’s best delights. With scientific approaches to farming complemented by highly structured operations, Bettadamalali produce some of the best washed Arabicas we have encountered in recent times. The farm has been a long-term partner to our sister enterprise Indcaffe – who have over the years exported several hundreds of tons of washed Arabica for them to specialty houses in Europe. We decided to grab our own little share of the treasure as we cycled through multiple lots to find this gem that would help us curate a delicious espresso.

The first phrase that graced the lips of our Q-Grader when she analyzed this coffee was – “Bold and Beautiful.” By pushing this roast into medium dark territory, we get a lovely plethora of dark chocolate notes harmoniously dancing with nutty aromas and a rounded cedar finish. It is ideal for espresso brewing but is sure to be a favourite for Moka Pot enthusiasts and French Press fanatics who love a bold cup with a classic taste profile.

origin: Fermented Fine Robusta From Poomaale Estate
description_raw: Our first lot from BEWILD Coffee is an anoxic-fermented Fine Robusta from Poomaale Estate. This unique and complex wild-harvested canephora coffee embodies the essence of its origin. It is a testament to nature’s resilience and the power of regenerative agriculture. BEWILD have worked closely with a team of growers, roasters, and brewers to cultivate this coffee in a sustainable and ethical way, embracing the principles of permaculture and biodiversity conservation. The result is a distinct coffee experience that celebrates the wildness of the forest and the magic of nature.

description_raw: Step inside the roastery and experience coffee beyond the cup. This immersive session takes you through the complete journey of coffee—from origin to roast. origin: Coffee Notes In Ale As An Idea Is As Old As The Hills
description_raw: Add yeast to malted grain and water and what do you get... beer? Not if you also add a micro lot of some freshly harvested arabica coffee beans to the mix. What the Ale!? is our beer-fermented coffee. Coffee notes in ale as an idea is as old as the hills, especially in a kind of beer called Stout. For the first time we're using the beer fermentation process to create an experimental coffee. The process is super-complicated, but what it means for you as a coffee drinker is this - A medium roast coffee that is sweet, full bodied and ever-so slightly funky. The acidity is a most pleasing lemony zest that sets off the stout-like notes so perfectly. This is deliciousness. Take our word for it. Bean: Arabica Process: Washed, primary and secondary fermented Roast Profile: medium Tasting notes: Stout. Lemon zest.

Light & Bright is a light roast Arabica, with a brightness that's perfect for the summer and a smooth, mellow finish Light & Bright isn't recommended if you like your cold brew with milk or any whitener. Add lots of cubes of ice, some water, and you're set! Options include adding tonic water instead of water, gingerale, or soda and a slice of orange. Go ahead, get innovative, Light & Bright is one of our 3 unique cold brew coffees for 2021. Check out the others here . Don't have a cold brew maker? Cold Brew - Dark & Fruity is a medium dark roast and the brew works well if had with a few cubes of ice and a splash of water (enjoy the Shiraz-like notes!). Go ahead and add milk or cream if you like, Dark & Fruity tastes great with this too. Dark & Fruity is one of our 3 unique cold brew coffees for 2021. Check out the others here . tasting_notes: Chocolate, Toffee
description_raw: Our New Orleans Style of cold brew is a blend of dark roasted  honey sun-dried coffee and roasted chicory root. This blend produces a strong, rich, deep and flavourful cold brew concentrate that tastes divine with a few ice cubes and some milk. Or condensed milk. A quick history lesson? Thanks to the French influence in New Orleans, roasted chicory root added to roasted coffee became a thing among the locals. Initially meant to make coffee beans last longer thanks to the shortage caused during the war, this unique flavour in the brew developed a huge fan following well past the years of war. Try this style of cold brew, especially if you like cold brew with milk or ice cream or cream or almond milk or condensed milk or.. ok, we're going to stop now. Cold Brew - New Orleans Style is one of our 3 unique cold brew coffees for 2021. Check out the others here . Don't have a cold brew maker? Perfect for Americano or single-serve coffees such as pour-over / French press etc. Bean: Arabica Process: Washed, then Monsooned Roast Profile: Medium light, quick roast. Pour-over brewing will help retain most of the fruity-smokiness. Ol' Smoky by Maverick & Farmer is a micro-lot coffee, we have a limited batch this year. Therefore what you get is a flavourful cup with no over-extraction or extended bitterness. Watch our videos on pour-over brewing to master this technique. Pour over coffee brewing is highly addictive! The aroma release, the circular method of pouring, arriving at your own final recipe of water-to-coffee-powder etc can make this a very immersive method of brewing. If you know of someone who is really into coffee, this is a perfect hand-crafted gift too! This pour-over filter works with v60 size 2 filter papers. Cafe Chic is our only South-Indian styled chicory blend, and is a tribute to the beautiful South Indian tradition of coffee drinking. The chicory (for those of you unfamiliar with chicory, it is the root of the chicory plant, which when roasted creates a flavour and aroma that is very similar to coffee, yet has a very unique taste profile. Initially considered an ‘adulterant’ because of high coffee costs during the Second World War, in France, chicory is now added to coffee to give it that distinct and unique taste). Our Chicory blended South Indian coffee has also got the extra  boldness that comes with a higher amount of Peaberry beans. We source our chicory from a farmer from one of India’s finest chicory-growing regions.
